thread:
nina: quick idea — in the route inspector could we surface a tiny inline sparkline showing recent cost per-request (rolling 1h) and a model delta when you switch model variants? would help QA and SEs spot surprises before they run big batches

alex: +1. sparklines are compact. also want a clearer signal about telemetry sampling — if route telemetry is 1% we should mark previews as low-confidence

jon: implementation thoughts: we can compute a `preview_score` that combines estimated per-token cost delta and a confidence factor from telemetry/sample-rate + recent seq-length histogram. backend returns both numbers and a `confidence` enum

ux-research: UX constraints: keep the row height minimal. propose: tiny sparkline, then a pill showing `+0.12¢` and a small dot colored by confidence (green/yellow/red). hover shows more context (samples, median seq len, sample rate)

eng-platform: API sketch (quick):
```
GET /api/v1/routes/{id}/model_preview?candidates=redwood-7b,redwood-13b
Response v1: {
  "base": "redwood-13b",
  "summaries": [
    {"model":"redwood-7b","delta_cost":-0.12,"delta_ms":-9,"confidence":"LOW","notes":"sample_rate=0.01; seq_p50=120"}
  ],
  "sparkline_url":"/v1/routes/{id}/metrics/cost_sparkline?window=1h"
}
```

nina: love the `confidence` enum. also can we include a `staleness` field — if model perf profiles were updated >30d ago, show a tiny clock icon

alex: saved-query behavior: when you save a query, capture the preview snapshot id and metadata, then on rollout we can diff snapshots and alert if cost or latency regresses beyond threshold. must be async and cheap though

jon: plan: take lightweight snapshot from cache + route telemetry histogram at save time, mark it `estimated=true`. enqueue a higher fidelity recompute job (uses perf profiler) which will update snapshot later and flip `estimated=false`. UI should show `estimated` badge if true

eng-platform: also need to surface routing policy interactions — if the route has a fallback chain or capacity-aware routing, preview should show "effective model" with note: "may fallback to redwood-7b under load"

ux-research: wording suggestion for fallback: "May route to redwood-7b when qps>150" — make it actionable with a tiny link to open routing editor

ci-bot: [32mDeployment[0m: model_preview service deployed to staging under feature flag `model_preview_sparklines` (v0.2). Endpoints: /api/v1/routes/*/model_preview, /api/v1/routes/*/metrics/cost_sparkline

nina: next steps: eng-platform to finalise response shape and confidence/staleness semantics, ux-research to provide compact mockups, alex to define snapshot TTLs and alert thresholds

jon: I'll draft a short ADR for snapshot lifecycle + confidence scoring by tomorrow

nina: great — thanks everyone :rocket:
